text:
A radiographer works in an area where there is a radioactive source.
The radiographer wears a lead apron.
How does the apron act as a safety precaution?
A
It increases the distance between the radiographer and the source.
B
It reduces the time that the radiographer is exposed to radiation.
C
It shields the radiographer by absorbing some of the radiation.
D
It stops radiation reaching the radiographer by reflecting the radiation.
